data.one_liner: Lint rules for Flutter and Dart projects created by the Flutterando Community.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of Flutter and Dart lint rules used across Flutterando's open source projects and packages. It includes multiple sets of rules like dart.yaml, flutter.yaml, and package variants with public_member_api_docs enabled.
use_when: You want to apply Flutterando's community-standard lint rules to your Dart or Flutter project.
You need pre-configured analysis options for packages or apps.
avoid_when: You prefer default Flutter lints or a different style guide entirely.
strengths: Curated by experienced senior Flutter developers from the Flutterando community.
Multiple configuration options depending on whether you are building an app or a package.
weaknesses: Limited documentation on the exact complete list of custom rules beyond referencing the repository files.
data.setup_notes: Add as a dev dependency in pubspec.yaml and include the desired configuration file in analysis_options.yaml.
